parameters.query:
SELECT 
  id,
  order_number,
  order_type,
  description,
  batch_id,
  branch_id,
  peddler_id,
  created_by,
  bad_order_quantity,
  new_can_quantity,
  new_can_total_amount,
  refill_quantity,
  refill_total_amount,
  other_brand_quantity,
  total_amount,
  is_paid,
  is_deleted,
  order_date,
  created_at,
  updated_at,
  batches
FROM orders
WHERE is_deleted = false
  AND ($1::timestamptz IS NULL OR order_date >= $1::timestamptz)
  AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR order_date <= ($2::timestamptz + interval '23 hours 59 minutes 59 seconds'))
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR $3::text = 'all' OR branch_id = $3)
  AND ($4::text IS NULL OR $4::text = 'all' OR batch_id = $4)
  AND ($5::text IS NULL OR $5::text = 'all' OR order_type = $5)
  AND ($6::text IS NULL OR $6::text = 'all' OR peddler_id = $6)
ORDER BY {{$json.sortBy || 'order_date'}} {{$json.sortOrder || 'DESC'}}
LIMIT $7 OFFSET $8;

SELECT COUNT(*) as total
FROM orders
WHERE is_deleted = false
  AND ($1::timestamptz IS NULL OR order_date >= $1::timestamptz)
  AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR order_date <= ($2::timestamptz + interval '23 hours 59 minutes 59 seconds'))
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR $3::text = 'all' OR branch_id = $3)
  AND ($4::text IS NULL OR $4::text = 'all' OR batch_id = $4)
  AND ($5::text IS NULL OR $5::text = 'all' OR order_type = $5)
  AND ($6::text IS NULL OR $6::text = 'all' OR peddler_id = $6);
